name: create_or_update_file
description: Create or update a single file in a GitHub repository

branch.description: Branch to create/update the file in

path.description: Path where to create/update the file

sha.description: SHA of the file being replaced (required when updating existing files)

name: query_logs
description: Runs a custom read-only ClickHouse SQL query against a Supabase project's unified logs stream, for filtering, aggregating, or joining across log fields more precisely than a simple per-service log dump. When the user asks about a specific time range, always pass iso_timestamp_start and iso_timestamp_end to match it; otherwise the query defaults to the last 24 hours and will return results from a wider window than intended. The window can be up to 24 hours. Do not poll this tool in a loop.

iso_timestamp_end.description: The end of the log window as an ISO 8601 timestamp, including a UTC "Z" suffix or explicit offset. Defaults to the current time. The API caps the requested range at 24 hours.

iso_timestamp_start.description: The start of the log window as an ISO 8601 timestamp, including a UTC "Z" suffix or explicit offset. Defaults to 24 hours before the end of the window. The API caps the requested range at 24 hours.

sql.description: A read-only ClickHouse SQL query to run against the project's unified logs stream. Logs are exposed through a `logs` table; filter by `source` (common values include 'edge_logs', 'postgres_logs', and 'function_edge_logs', but this list is not exhaustive — run `select distinct source from logs` to discover the sources available for this project) and read nested fields via `log_attributes['<key>']`.

name: create_dns_record
description: Create a DNS record (A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT, MX, etc). Requires confirm:true (human-approval gate); without it returns a preview only.

confirm.description: Human-approval gate: must be true to actually perform this mutating operation. Omit or set false to get a non-executing preview of what would happen (with secrets redacted). A human should approve before this is set to true.

content.description: Record value (IP, target host, text, etc).

name.description: Record name (e.g. www.example.com or @ for root).

proxied.description: Whether traffic is proxied through Cloudflare (A/AAAA/CNAME only).

zone_id.description: The Cloudflare zone ID (32-char hex). Get it from list_zones.

name: emulate
description: Emulates various features on the target page. Each call replaces all emulation settings (except extraHttpHeaders), so pass all desired settings in a single call.

colorScheme.description: Emulate the dark or the light mode. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

cpuThrottlingRate.description: Represents the CPU slowdown factor. Omit or set the rate to 1 to disable throttling

extraHttpHeaders.description: Extra HTTP headers as a JSON string object, e.g. {"X-Custom": "value", "Authorization": "Bearer token"}. Headers are included into every HTTP request originating from the page and persist across navigations until cleared. Pass an empty string to clear all extra headers.

forcedColors.description: Emulate the `forced-colors` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

geolocation.description: Geolocation (`<latitude>,<longitude>`) to emulate. Latitude between -90 and 90. Longitude between -180 and 180. Omit to clear the geolocation override.

networkConditions.description: Throttle network. Omit to disable throttling.

pageId.description: Targets a specific page by ID.

prefersContrast.description: Emulate the `prefers-contrast` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

prefersReducedMotion.description: Emulate the `prefers-reduced-motion` CSS media feature. Omit or set to "auto" to reset to the default.

userAgent.description: User agent to emulate. Omit or set to empty string to clear the user agent override.

viewport.description: Emulate device viewports '<width>x<height>x<devicePixelRatio>[,mobile][,touch][,landscape]'. 'touch' and 'mobile' to emulate mobile devices. 'landscape' to emulate landscape mode. Omit to clear the viewport override.
